lines: [SYSTEM] 🔴 LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
[SYSTEM] TONIGHT: YOU stands accused — THEFT — TAKING WHAT WASN'T THEIRS! The gamblers are FRENZIED! Place your bets, place your bets!
Linda calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
[SYSTEM] 🔴 LIVE — THE VERDICT IS IN! The galaxy holds its breath!
The fire is built high. Nobody speaks while the count is taken — you can hear the wind past the edge of the light.
Linda counts on their fingers, twice, like they don't trust the first number. Then, to the fire: "8 for guilty. 0 against."
A pause long enough to live in. Someone's breath catches. Then: "Guilty." Nobody looks at anybody.
The sentence is spoken low, like something heavy set down. "You pay. And stay — this time."
Food, work, public apology — You pay it in the open, where everyone can see. The price of staying.
Nobody says Linda was right. Nobody has to. The way the fire settles says it.

A pause long enough to live in. Someone's breath catches. Then: "Guilty." Nobody looks at anybody.
The oldest among them stands. The fire seems to lean in. "You — take what you can carry and go."
◈ CRISIS — THE SCHISM. You are cast out. The village chose, and the choosing cut something that won’t heal clean. The fire keeps burning without you.
SYSTEM: "Social unit ejected. The audience is divided. Half of them are furious. The other half is also furious, but differently."
Exiled. You leave with what you carry — nothing more. Behind you, Haven keeps its fire. Ahead: the world, which just got much bigger.
Be off Haven’s ground by dawn. Still here when the sun’s up, and they won’t ask twice — they’ll come.
📓 Codex: Exiled (moot). Walking.
The pantry is closed to you. The book stays behind. To Haven, you are not one of ours anymore. Membership asked nothing — no presence, no check-ins. Exile is the one way to lose it.
Linda doesn't gloat. Nobody thanks them out loud. But the nods they get by the fire, later — those are real.

transcript.text: "I asked James about this wound — James's gone. Still need hands. Are you in? Let's move."
"Right. That's what I figured — which is why I asked you, not them. Trust me. Mostly."
"a ridge with a view for miles — I'll show you on the map sometime. It's real."
"Sofia is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"I just told you — what else is on your mind?"
"About what's been happening — we never finished."
"I clean up other people's messes quietly. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."
"What's the worst thing you've done since the sky changed?"
"Yes. I don't want to get into what. But yes."
No judgment in their face. "We're all doing math that doesn't add up. You're still here. That counts."
"The math doesn't add up out here. Be kind to yourself about the remainders."
"We bury, we grieve, we keep going. There's no step four."
"James and I never finished talking about that favor — we got cut off, 2 days back. You're wearing James's shoes now — want to pick it up? We still owe what's been happening a proper ending, too."
"Heh. You really want my take? ...Yeah. Okay. I think we're being tested."
"I hate to ask, but do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? My hands shake when I try to work."
"Watch for this: It doesn't move. Speedbump, every time. It hunts by day — watch the open ground."
"About what's been happening — that was James's thread. We never finished."
I haven't eaten right in days. I need food before I can't work at all.
"You asked me that before. It's a different question now." "Since Sofia died... I keep expecting to see Sofia at the fire. Stupid."
"I wish there was more to tell. That's it."
"So." They look at the fire for a moment.
"Good — what's been happening, settled. Feels better said out loud."
"About this wound — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you? This isn't new."
You walk to the ridge with Carmine. Nothing much there — but they talk the whole way, and you learn the shape of them a little better.
"Linda is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"It's getting worse, not better. If it festers I'm no good to anyone — can't haul, can't hunt, can't watch. Just clean it out and wrap it tight."
"About what's been happening — we never finished."
"I check everyone's shoes for wear. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."
They relax, a fraction. This is going well.
"Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
"Good. Anger's fuel. Just — point it somewhere useful. Just... be straight with me."
"Feel it, then use it. That's the whole trick. I'm still learning it myself."
"My part? I remember them. Someone has to do it properly."
"I wish we had longer. Soon, yeah?"
Carmine has been stockpiling where nobody looks. "Take half. You've got the hands for it." (+4 wood, +4 fiber to the village stash.)
"You asked me that before. It's a different question now." "Sofia is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"I just said — did you miss it?"
"About what's been happening — we never finished."
A warmth settles over the conversation — they lean in a little.
They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.
"...What's that supposed to mean?" Their voice goes careful.
"Alright, love. Go do what you need to do."
"What are you getting at?" A glance away, then back. They're choosing their words now.
"About this wound — still need hands. Are you in?"
"Here. I made an extra." Carmine presses something into your hand — a decent tool, oiled and kept. (Useful. Keep it.)
"I just said — did you miss it?"
"About what's been happening — we never finished."
"I just told you — what else is on your mind?"
Something eases in their shoulders. They're really talking to you now.
They're rattled — hands busy, eyes everywhere but on you. "I've told you what I've told you."
"I could talk all day, but — go on. We'll talk more."
They shake their head — not no, not yes. Done talking about it.
"I just said — did you miss it?"
"You asked me that before. It's a different question now." "Since Sofia died... I keep expecting to see Sofia at the fire. Stupid."
"I just told you — what else is on your mind?"
"About what's been happening — we never finished."
"We've covered this one. Ask me something else."
"What do you make of all this? Really."
"Bleak. Probably true. I keep looking for the part where it's not. How are you holding up, though?"
"Say it plain. I turn it over and over. Maybe the answer's in the turning, not the landing."
"So." They look at the fire for a moment.
They shake their head — not no, not yes. Done talking about it.
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
